title: Thayananth Kumaresan · Online STEM Tutor
description: Online one-to-one tutoring in Computer Science, Mathematics and Science with Thayananth Kumaresan. Book a free one-hour trial on WhatsApp.
message: Hi! I’d like to book a free one-hour trial class for my child. Could you share your availability?

sections.label: ONLINE PRIVATE TUTORING · MALAYSIA
sections.heading:
Meet your
next tutor.
sections.body: One-to-one online lessons in Asas Sains Komputer, Sains Komputer, Mathematics and Science for secondary students. We work through tricky topics together and build confidence through practice.

sections.label: MY TEACHING APPROACH
sections.heading: Make it click.
sections.body: I start by finding the step that feels confusing. Then we work through an example together and your child tries a similar one on their own.

cards.heading: Learn by doing
cards.body: We draw, discuss and practise so I can see how your child is thinking.

cards.heading: A pace that fits
cards.body: We leave room for questions and spend extra time where it makes a difference.

sections.label: WHAT WE CAN WORK ON
sections.heading: Subjects I teach
sections.body: Online lessons for Malaysian secondary students. Here’s what I teach by form level.

cards.heading: Computer Science
cards.body: Asas Sains Komputer (ASK) for Forms 1–3 and Sains Komputer for Forms 4–5.

cards.heading: Mathematics
cards.body: Forms 1–3. Work through examples and practise explaining each step.

cards.heading: Science
cards.body: Forms 1–3. Make sense of key ideas with diagrams, everyday examples, and guided questions.

sections.label: WHAT YOUR CHILD RECEIVES
sections.heading: Support in class and between lessons

cards.heading: Individual lessons
cards.body: One-to-one attention in every class.

cards.heading: Slides, notes & resources
cards.body: Materials your child can revisit when they need a refresher.

cards.heading: Quizzes
cards.body: Quick checks to see what your child understands and where they need help.

cards.heading: Homework after class
cards.body: Practice to reinforce what we worked on together.

cards.heading: Tests by chapter
cards.body: Track progress chapter by chapter and see what needs more practice.

cards.heading: School project guidance
cards.body: Help breaking down the task and planning the next steps.

cards.heading: Quick recap
cards.body: Recall the key ideas from the previous lesson.

cards.heading: One new concept
cards.body: Break it down and work through an example together.

cards.heading: Guided practice
cards.body: Try questions with support as needed.

cards.heading: Quick quiz
cards.body: Check understanding and spot anything that’s still unclear.

cards.heading: Review & homework
cards.body: Recap, share feedback and set homework.

sections.label: FOR PARENTS
sections.heading: Your first class, step by step

cards.heading: Tell me what’s tricky
cards.body: Share your child’s year level, subject and a topic or homework question they’d like help with.

cards.heading: Try a free one-hour class
cards.body: Your child will learn a concept and work through practice questions with me.

cards.heading: Talk through next steps
cards.body: After the trial, I’ll share what I noticed and what we could practise next.

sections.label: YOUR FIRST LESSON
sections.heading: Try a full hour, free.
sections.body: Your child can experience my teaching style in a free, one-to-one, 60-minute trial class. Afterwards, you can decide whether to continue. Send me their year level and subject on WhatsApp to find a time.

profile.title: Tutor Profile · Thayananth Kumaresan
profile.description: Meet Thayananth Kumaresan, a Computer Science graduate and online STEM tutor based in Petaling Jaya, Selangor.

sections.body: I tutor secondary students online and coach children and teens in coding, digital creation, and AI literacy. I adapt the pace to each learner and use questions and hands-on practice to help them explain what they understand.

sections.label: WHAT GUIDES MY LESSONS
sections.heading: How I work with your child

cards.heading: Make it hands-on
cards.body: We draw diagrams, work through examples, and talk through the reasoning.

cards.heading: Notice the small wins
cards.body: A quiz or short practice question helps us see what’s clicked and what to revisit.

sections.label: BEFORE THE TRIAL
sections.heading: Tell me a little about your child
sections.body: Their year level and one topic they find difficult are enough to get started. You can also share a recent worksheet or project question so we have something familiar to work on.

experience.title: Teaching Experience · Thayananth Kumaresan
experience.description: Teaching experience in one-to-one secondary tutoring, coding classes, school enrichment and mentoring.

sections.label: TEACHING EXPERIENCE
sections.heading: Where I’ve taught
sections.body: My teaching experience spans online private tutoring, coding classes, and school enrichment. I’ve worked with children and teens in both individual and mixed-ability classes.

cards.heading: Online private tutor
cards.body: One-to-one online tuition in ASK, Science and Mathematics for Forms 1–3, and Sains Komputer for Forms 4–5.

cards.heading: CCA coach at Sri KDU Subang Jaya
cards.body: Through MySchool, I coach Digital Creators Club and AI & Future Innovators Lab. Students use Canva and CapCut, practise responsible AI use, and create projects they can present.

cards.heading: Part-time tutor at Algorithmics
cards.body: Taught Scratch, Python, HTML/CSS, data science and app development. Adapted tasks for mixed-ability groups and updated parents at learning milestones.

cards.heading: Tutor at Arena Matriks Tuition Centre
cards.body: Taught Science and Mathematics in group lessons for Standards 4–6.

cards.heading: Tutor at Ascension (Astra)
cards.body: Delivered one-to-one tuition in IGCSE Combined Science.

cards.heading: Teach For Malaysia mentor
cards.body: Mentored in Program Komuniti Perkasa and led an eco-art activity.

cards.heading: Practise the skill
cards.body: Your child gets a short follow-up task alongside notes or resources to refer to.

cards.heading: Check understanding
cards.body: In later lessons, recap questions and chapter tests help us see what has stuck.

cards.heading: Choose the next focus
cards.body: We use the results to decide what needs more practice and when to move on.
